items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Lunceford's show band came in and I rehearsed them

ctx.x: And well, it wasn't '22. Yeah, I met Duke right after I came -- no, it must have been later. It was about, say, '25. Because it was right before Small's opened up on 135th Street, and the Savoy Ballroom, it was right before then that I met Duke -- but it was at the Robinson Restaurant, see, and I used to go up, when Duke was rehearsing, I used to hang around, you know, I used to hang around his place, and then I went to -- when he went to the Cotton Club, that was in '27, I used to go up there all the time, see,…

After they played Philadelphia and came back, their pay jumped --and Duke was at the Cotton Club, and I used to go up there all the time hanging around, listening, and I was rehearsing shows all the time, then, see, and Jimmy Lunceford's show band came in and I rehearsed them, and when I got through rehearsing, I went out in the street and told the guy, man, this was the greatest band in the world. Ah!
